target.name: linear_eigenvalue_increments
target.inverse: cumulative sum; do NOT silently sort predictions
target.scaler_policy: StandardScaler fit on TRAINING-CORE targets only, frozen, applied elsewhere unchanged

closed_alternatives.log_gaps: ONE bounded post-baseline ablation on the leading encoder only

primary_metric.name: mean_spatial_fold_equal_shell_macro_R2_lambda1
primary_metric.per_fold: R2(lambda1) over ALL authoritative validation-core galaxies, per reporting shell; equal-weight mean over the four shells
primary_metric.summary: mean over blocked folds, reported with fold scatter and spatial-block interval
primary_metric.shell_weight_objective: w_i = N_s^-0.5; patch sampling proportional to sum of core w_i

mandatory_safeguards: worst-shell and per-shell R2 all eigenvalues
promotion_gate: mean gain >= 0.03 primary score vs matched frozen baseline; smaller gains provisional unless uncertainty clearly supports them; no shell degradation erasing the gain
